turns.question: On which day of the week were the most orders placed between 17 August and 27 September 2026, and how many orders were placed on that weekday in total?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no weekday grouping, so it cannot name the weekday with the most orders or give that weekday's total; its daily order counts for 17 August to 27 September 2026 (42 days) ran between 3 and 5 a day, and I did not add them up by weekday myself. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
